title: PlanResponse
description: The assistant's answer to a planning question. Every figure in it comes from the scoring engine; the model supplies the sentence, not the facts.

verdict.description: Whether the conditions suit the activity.

best_window.description: The highest ranked window, or null when nothing clears the profile.

reason.description: One or two sentences explaining the verdict, in the language the question was asked in.

warnings.description: Conditions worth flagging even when the verdict is good. Empty when there are none.

score.description: Mean comfort score across the window, 0 to 100.

temp_min_c.description: Coldest hour in the window. Computed by the scoring engine and attached to the answer — the model never produces a figure a person reads (ADR-0007).

precip_prob_max_pct.description: Highest chance of precipitation across the window.

weather_code.description: The most severe WMO code in the window — what the interface names the conditions from.
